title: elytrigia intermedia subsp. gentryi
intro: Elytrigia intermedia subsp. gentryi, commonly known as Gentry's needlegrass or intermediate wildrye, is a plant species belonging to the family Poaceae. It has been used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, making it a potential therapeutic agent for the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Elytrigia intermedia subsp. gentryi include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. Further research is needed to fully elucidate the therapeutic actions and health benefits of this plant species.
